gameName: Eclipse: New Dawn for the Galaxy

modules.name: Alien species
modules.note: Recommended from the second game on.

steps.text: Ship Part tiles and the Round marker on the Supply board
Shuffle the Technology tiles in a bag; draw {n} onto the Research tracks, stacking matching tiles
Reputation tiles in the other bag
Discovery tiles shuffled facedown on their spot; Ancient Ships, Orbitals and Monoliths, Damage cubes and the Traitor card on the board
Galactic Center in the middle: a facedown Discovery tile and the Defense System tile on it
Sector hexes facedown in 3 stacks: all Inner (I), all Middle (II), {n} random Outer (III)
Starting Player marker to whoever has spent the least time on Terra
With aliens: from the starting player's right, counterclockwise, each picks a species (choosing Terrans removes one alien species)
From the starting player clockwise: take a start hex and its Player Board; place it on the nearest start spot two hexes from the Center
In the same order place your species' start hex on the nearest start spot two hexes from the Center
Box the unused start hexes and boards
All Ships, Ambassadors, discs and cubes of your colour, 3 Colony Ships (Planta: 4) and a Summary card (Action side up)
An Influence Disc on every circle of the Influence track (Eridani: leave the 2 rightmost empty)
A Population cube on every square of the 3 Population tracks except the lighter rightmost one
Storage markers: Money 2, Science 3, Materials 3 (aliens: their species' values)
On your start hex: 1 Interceptor (Orion: a Cruiser), a cube on each normal Population square from its track, 1 Influence Disc from your track
Eridani Empire
details: Start: 26 Money, 2 Science, 4 Materials; hex 222; Gauss Shield, Fusion Drive, Plasma Cannon
Reputation: draws 2 random Reputation tiles at the start
Influence: 2 fewer discs
Trade: 3:1; own ship blueprints

steps.text: Hydran Progress
details: Start: 2 Money, 5 Science, 2 Materials; hex 224; Advanced Labs
Setup: an extra cube on the Advanced Science square of the start hex
Research: may buy 2 Technologies per action
Trade: 3:1

steps.text: Planta
details: Start: 4 Money, 4 Science, 4 Materials; hex 226; Starbase; 4 Colony Ships
Explore: may explore 2 hexes per action
Fragile: enemy Ships destroy their Population cubes after combat
Growth: 1 extra VP per controlled hex at game end
Trade: 3:1; own ship blueprints

steps.text: Descendants of Draco
details: Start: 2 Money, 4 Science, 3 Materials; hex 228
Explore: turn 2 hexes and keep one, or discard both
Ancients: 1 VP per Ancient Ship left on the board at game end
Trade: 3:1

steps.text: Mechanema
details: Start: 3 Money, 3 Science, 3 Materials; hex 230; Positron Computer
Upgrade: up to 3 Ship Part tiles per action
Build: up to 3 Ships or Structures per action, at lower cost
Trade: 3:1

steps.text: Orion Hegemony
details: Start: 3 Money, 3 Science, 5 Materials; hex 232; Neutron Bombs, Gauss Shield; a Cruiser instead of an Interceptor
Trade: 4:1; own ship blueprints

steps.text: Move: Terrans make 3 Ship movements, every alien species only 2
Upkeep: pay the Money shown on the leftmost empty Influence circle
Ships, cubes, discs and tiles are limited; Ship Parts, Orbitals and Damage cubes are not
The starting player takes the first action
